mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_master ( stock_code, stock_name, market_type, sector_name, industry_name, corp_code, is_active ) VALUES ( #{stockCode}, #{stockName}, #{marketType}, #{sectorName}, #{industryName}, #{corpCode}, #{isActive} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stock_name = VALUES(stock_name), market_type = CASE WHEN VALUES(market_type) IS NULL OR VALUES(market_type) = 'UNKNOWN' THEN market_type ELSE VALUES(market_type) END, sector_name = COALESCE(VALUES(sector_name), sector_name), industry_name = COALESCE(VALUES(industry_name), industry_name), corp_code = COALESCE(VALUES(corp_code), corp_code), is_active = VALUES(is_active), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT stock_code, stock_name, market_type, sector_name, industry_name, corp_code, is_active, listed_date, delisted_date, created_at, updated_at FROM stock_master WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode}

SELECT stock_code, stock_name, market_type, sector_name, industry_name, corp_code, is_active, listed_date, delisted_date, created_at, updated_at FROM stock_master WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY stock_code
SELECT stock_code, stock_name, market_type, sector_name, industry_name, corp_code, is_active, listed_date, delisted_date, created_at, updated_at FROM stock_master ORDER BY stock_name, stock_code
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_master SET market_type = #{marketType}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode}
UPDATE stock_master SET is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode}
